name: reinwatch
description: A token and runaway watchdog for the subagents, teammates and workflow agents Claude Code runs: per-agent tokens, warnings, notifications and history, with a way to stop one.

activeMinutes.title: Long-run warning (minutes)
activeMinutes.description: Warn when one agent has worked longer than this. Model and tool time count; waiting does not.

tokenMillions.title: Token warning (millions)
tokenMillions.description: Warn when one agent has taken in more new tokens than this: input, cache writes and output. Cache reads are not counted.

repeatCount.title: Repeat warning (calls)
repeatCount.description: Warn when one agent makes the same tool call with the same input this many times.

failStreak.title: Failure warning (in a row)
failStreak.description: Warn after this many tool failures in a row from one agent.

burstCount.title: Burst warning (agents)
burstCount.description: Warn when this many agents start within the burst window, or one workflow run starts this many.

burstMinutes.title: Burst window (minutes)
burstMinutes.description: The window the burst warning counts agent starts in.

notify.title: Send notifications
notify.description: Raise each warning as a notification, which your own Notification hooks can turn into an OS notification.

openPaneOnWarning.title: Open the pane on a warning
openPaneOnWarning.description: Open the agent pane when a warning fires.

redact.title: Mask key-like text
redact.description: Mask strings that look like keys or tokens in agent descriptions.
